invalidWindow: Minimum depth must be less than or equal to maximum depth.
failed: Could not open the well log.
candidate: Flag causes have not been reviewed. Original values are unchanged.
sampling: Source {total} rows · window {matched} rows · display {shown} rows
truncated: Display limit reached. Continue in source rows to inspect the remainder.
reduction: Display reduction preserves bucket extrema and missing boundaries. Do not analyze display samples.
exact: Row IDs are LAS logical samples, not physical text lines including headers.
noDepth: No finite depth. Inspect source rows and metadata.
mismatch: Manifest columns or units disagree with the data file. Track rendering stopped.
noFlags: No review flags. This viewer does not run range or spike screening.
